bossbarhider.title: BossBar Hider
bossbarhider.subtitle: Choose which boss bars appear on your HUD
bossbarhider.tester.tooltip: Test your draft rules against a sample boss bar. Collapses automatically in small windows.
bossbarhider.tester.title: Sample boss bar title
bossbarhider.tester.active.tooltip: Copy an active boss bar into the tester. Click again to cycle through all bars, including hidden ones.
bossbarhider.save.tooltip: Save and apply all changes. Cancel or Escape discards this draft.
bossbarhider.save.error: Save failed. Draft kept; check the log and retry.
bossbarhider.load.error: Config unreadable. Saving backs up the original file.
bossbarhider.rules.hint: All conditions in a rule must match. Any matching rule hides the bar.
bossbarhider.rules.empty: No rules yet. Add a rule to get started.
bossbarhider.rule.title: Title condition (case-insensitive). Leave empty to filter only by color or flags.
bossbarhider.rule.empty: Choose at least one condition. Empty rules hide nothing.
bossbarhider.rule.no_match: Does not match the sample boss bar
bossbarhider.rule.conditions: Title, color and flags are combined with AND.
bossbarhider.mode.tooltip: Title matching: contains, exact, starts with or ends with. Always case-insensitive.
bossbarhider.flag.tooltip: %s flag: Any ignores it, Yes requires it, No requires its absence. Only the bar is hidden; world effects stay unchanged.
